pro_course_detail.description:
English Conversation and Grammar Practice – For All Levels

Welcome to a fun and interactive English learning experience, designed to help you build confidence and improve your skills in both conversation and grammar, no matter your current level. Whether you're just starting out or looking to refine your proficiency, this course offers tailored lessons to help you succeed.

What you'll get:

Conversational Practice: Engage in lively and real-world conversations to improve your speaking fluency and listening comprehension. You’ll gain the confidence to speak English in a variety of situations, from casual chats to formal discussions.

Grammar Mastery: We’ll break down key grammar rules in an easy-to-understand way, helping you use them correctly in your speaking and writing. With practice exercises and examples, you’ll gradually master important grammar concepts at your own pace.

Vocabulary Building: As we cover different topics in our conversations, you'll naturally expand your vocabulary, learning words and phrases that are used in everyday English.

Personalized Lessons: Whether you're a beginner or an advanced learner, the lessons are customized to meet your unique needs. We'll focus on areas where you need improvement, helping you progress quickly.

Interactive and Fun: Learning doesn’t have to be boring! Expect engaging activities and exercises that make learning enjoyable and effective. Practice speaking and grammar in a relaxed and supportive environment, where you can ask questions and get instant feedback.

Join me for engaging lessons that will help you grow as an English speaker, improve your grammar, and feel more comfortable communicating in English. Book your session today and take the next step toward mastering the language!

pro_course_detail.description:
Teaching English to people who might be traveling internationally or even locally because English is used almost everywhere. 
I'll teach on how to understand people you meet that are not speaking the same language that you speak,  and learn to speak with them using English.
Travel English ties in very nicely with the countable and uncountable nouns that you are going to use in your travel communication, such as accommodation/ hotel, language/ suitcase, and many more.
this is the list of places or situations you will need to use English in Hotels or any other accommodations you will need to speak to host family, bellboy, maid reception staff, etc.
Restaurants or pubs- barman or waiter.
Shops - shop assistance
Airport - check-in staff, immigration customs, security people, lost luggage desk staff, etc.
Aeroplan - fellow passengers and cabin staff.
Bus, coach, or train stations - Ticket counter staff, fellow passengers, information desk, ticket barrier staff.
Taxi and Taxi ranks - Driver or other people waiting.
Tourists site - Tour guide ticket office staff.
The streets - passerby or police officers.
There are so many more places that will need your English such as police stations, car rentals, lost luggage, petrol stations, requesting, thanking, responding to offers, greeting, complaining, responding to apologies, responding to suggestions, and many more.
In my classroom, we will be learning Travelling English focusing on vocabulary, pronunciation, grammar, and phonetics.
